messages:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy smoke run finished for release v2026.03.19-rc4. Summary: 97% green, 3% degraded on embed-service kv-warmup probe. Rolling metrics attached. :warning:
alex: seeing the embed kv probe spike around 20:03 UTC? what metric specifically degraded?
maria: kv-warmup fail rate climbed to ~12% for the eu embed pool during warmup window, p95 latency 1.2s -> 2.6s on a subset of hosts. p50 stable.
chris: repro check: ran `curl -sS https://eu-embed.example/health | jq .` returns `{\"kv_warmup\": \"timeout\"}` on host eu-embed-7a.
ops-synth-bot: synthetic run 2233459999:kv-warmup-eu - failures=6/50, avg_latency=1.9s, p95=2.6s, CPU spike correlated on node eu-embed-7a.
jamie: CPU spike from a concurrent weird batch job? any recent daemon config changes in this release that affect warmup threading?
maria: RC4 only changed kv cache priming order and added an async prefetch worker (default concurrency 4). suspect contention when combined with existing batching.
alex: quick mitigation: lower prefetch concurrency to 1 for eu and rerun smoke. can we hotpatch config via rollout?
sre-lead: we can pin the eu embed pool to previous model variant (v2.3.0-quant) for in-flight traffic while we test a patch. that buys time without full rollback. opinions?
chris: +1 to pin, less risk than rollback. Also suggest temporary canary hold for other regions until eu stabilizes.
jamie: I'll push a small config roll to reduce prefetch to 1 on eu-only infragroup now. command: `deployctl set-config embed/eu prefetch_concurrency=1 --target=eu --note \"hotpatch: reduce warmup contention\"`
deploy-bot: enacting pin: routing eu->model:v2.3.0-quant for 20% bench traffic, canary hold set for further rollouts.
ops-synth-bot: kicking synthetic smoke after config change...
ops-synth-bot: run 2233460090:kv-warmup-eu - failures=1/50, avg_latency=0.9s, p95=1.1s. improvement noted. :thumbsup:
maria: looks good. but still want a follow-up fix to prefetch worker to avoid regression under load. opening an issue and linking to release notes.
chris: for release notes: add bullet under \"Known post-deploy mitigations\" about eu kv-warmup and temporary pin. also note customer impact: no customer API errors observed, only internal warmup probe failures.
sre-lead: decision: do not rollback. Pin eu to previous model variant and keep global rollout paused for 30m while we monitor. If failures <1% in next 30m, continue staggered rollout.
alex: ack. I'll monitor dashboards and update the release notes PR.
jamie: will create a small code patch to set default prefetch to 1 behind a flag and run integration.
chris: tagging @product for release-notes blurb, will push to changelog draft.
deploy-bot: action items logged: #3245 pin eu model, #3246 patch prefetch default and flag, #3247 update release notes. Rolling hold window expires in 30m unless cancelled.
sre-lead: nice quick recovery, thanks everyone. keep eyes on p95 and warmup failures.
ops-synth-bot: periodic check scheduled every 5m for next 30m.
